question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
-- Get the full count of actors who made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director
WITH yc_films AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID) AS ActorPID, p.Name AS ActorName, d.PID AS DirectorPID
    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN M_Director d ON c.MID = d.MID
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(c.PID) = p.PID
    WHERE d.PID = 'nm0007181'
),
actor_yash_count AS (
    SELECT ActorPID, ActorName, COUNT(*) AS yc_count
    FROM yc_films
    GROUP BY ActorPID, ActorName
),
actor_other_counts AS (
    SELECT TRIM(c.PID) AS ActorPID, d.PID AS DirectorPID, COUNT(DISTINCT c.MID) AS other_count
    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN M_Director d ON c.MID = d.MID
    WHERE d.PID != 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY TRIM(c.PID), d.PID
),
actor_max_other AS (
    SELECT ActorPID, MAX(other_count) AS max_other_count
    FROM actor_other_counts
    GROUP BY ActorPID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_actors
FROM actor_yash_count ayc
LEFT JOIN actor_max_other amo ON ayc.ActorPID = amo.ActorPID
WHERE ayc.yc_count > COALESCE(amo.max_other_count, 0)

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- For each actor who worked with Yash Chopra, count films with each director
-- Then find the max count for any other director and compare
WITH yc_films AS (
    -- Get all actor-director pairs for Yash Chopra films
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID) AS ActorPID, p.Name AS ActorName, d.PID AS DirectorPID
    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN M_Director d ON c.MID = d.MID
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(c.PID) = p.PID
    WHERE d.PID = 'nm0007181'
),
actor_yash_count AS (
    SELECT ActorPID, ActorName, COUNT(*) AS yc_count
    FROM yc_films
    GROUP BY ActorPID, ActorName
),
actor_other_counts AS (
    -- For each actor, count films with each OTHER director
    SELECT TRIM(c.PID) AS ActorPID, d.PID AS DirectorPID, COUNT(DISTINCT c.MID) AS other_count
    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN M_Director d ON c.MID = d.MID
    WHERE d.PID != 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY TRIM(c.PID), d.PID
),
